inShort: A serves out of a short two-step walk-in, and B returns calmly or rolls the ball back. 10 serves, then swap.
rules: A stands about 60 cm behind the baseline, feet apart. B stands at the far baseline, cross-court.
A takes a small shuffle step: the paddle-side foot moves toward the other foot.
Then the other foot steps up to just behind the baseline, and A hits the serve there.
The weight rolls forward onto the front foot as A serves deep cross-court.
B returns calmly or rolls the ball back. After 10 serves, swap roles.
tooEasy: 8 of 10 serves land in the back third of the service box. Even harder: switch the target between backhand, middle and line.
tooHard: Walk in a few times without a ball, then serve slowly. Serves go long: hit lower over the net, not softer.
goodLooksLike: The front hip points at the target as A hits, and A finishes with the weight over the front foot.
